disorders.name: Relationship distress with spouse or partner
disorders.nameZh: 与配偶或伴侣的关系困扰

sections.head: Essential (required) features
sections.en: Clinically significant distress or impairment in functioning related to conflict, dissatisfaction or discord in the relationship with a spouse or intimate partner.
sections.zh: 与配偶或亲密伴侣的关系冲突、不满或不和相关的临床显著痛苦或功能损害。

disorders.name: Caregiver-child relationship problem
disorders.nameZh: 照护者-儿童关系问题

sections.head: Essential (required) features
sections.en: Problems in the relationship between a child and a caregiver (e.g. parent) that are associated with clinically significant distress or impairment.
sections.zh: 儿童与照护者（如父母）之间关系的问题，伴有临床显著痛苦或损害。

disorders.name: Physical maltreatment, spouse or partner
disorders.nameZh: 配偶或伴侣躯体虐待

sections.head: Essential (required) features
sections.en: Physical maltreatment of a spouse or partner (or a personal history of such violence).
sections.zh: 对配偶或伴侣的躯体虐待（或此类暴力的个人史）。

sections.head: Essential (required) features
sections.en: Assault by neglect (e.g. neglect of a dependent person causing harm).
sections.zh: 因忽视（如对受抚养者的忽视造成伤害）所致的伤害。

disorders.name: Acute stress reaction
disorders.nameZh: 急性应激反应

sections.head: Essential (required) features
sections.en: A transient condition that develops in response to an exceptional stressful event (e.g. natural disaster, accident, assault). Symptoms (e.g. intrusive experiences, dissociative symptoms, anxiety, autonomic arousal) begin within hours to days of the event and typically subside within days to weeks.
sections.zh: 对异常应激事件（如自然灾害、事故、袭击）产生的短暂反应。症状（闯入性体验、分离症状、焦虑、自主神经唤起）在事件后数小时至数天内出现，通常在数天至数周内消退。
